title: Gearbox
subtitle: Sheet 1 of 3
text:
A gearbox turns a fast, weak shaft into a slow, strong one. The large gear has twelve teeth and the small one nine.

Every sheet in this sample is drawn by the book's own style: blue paper with a grid, white ink, white line art and the uniform font.
caption: Side view, not to scale

steps.title: Fit the housing
steps.text: Slide both gears onto their shafts and close the case.
With Simple Machines installed, a crank turns the input shaft.
